title: Vintage Posters & Graphic Design
description: Public-domain poster art — Art Nouveau, Belle Époque, and golden-age design.

items.title: Gismonda
items.description_narrative: A woman in a richly patterned robe stands holding a palm frond, a floral wreath in her hair, framed by mosaic-patterned lettering announcing a theater production. Alphonse Mucha designed this poster for Sarah Bernhardt in 1894; this impression is in Prague's Museum of Decorative Arts (Uměleckoprůmyslové muzeum v Praze).
items.tags: art nouveau, mucha, poster, lithograph, theater, fin de siecle
items.credit_line: Museum of Decorative Arts in Prague, 1894 poster; Category:Gismonda poster (Mucha)

items.title: Moulin Rouge: La Goulue
items.description_narrative: A dancer in a frilled white skirt kicks high before a crowd of top-hatted silhouettes. In the foreground, an exaggerated dark figure with elongated features claps along to the music. Bold red and black lettering announces the venue and star performer.
items.tags: can-can dancer, silhouette crowd, nightlife, bold lettering, cabaret, motion
items.credit_line: HwHWsv1o7adJ3A at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Divan Japonais
items.description_narrative: A woman in a black gown and dramatic feathered hat gestures toward a stage, an older gentleman in a top hat and gloves seated close beside her. The neck of a double bass rises between them in silhouette. Bold black lettering names the venue above.
items.tags: cabaret, top hat, silhouette, nightlife, stage view, black and yellow

items.title: Aristide Bruant dans son cabaret
items.description_narrative: A man in a broad black hat and flowing black cape stands wrapped in a bright red scarf, gripping a walking stick in a gloved hand. Behind him, a silhouetted figure watches from a doorway rimmed in cool blue. Bold, flat blocks of orange and navy give the composition its punch.
items.tags: cabaret, black hat, red scarf, silhouette, bold color, portrait

items.title: Jane Avril (Jardin de Paris)
items.description_narrative: A dancer in a flowing orange dress and black stockings high-kicks across a stage, the scrolled neck and strings of a double bass looming in silhouette in the foreground. Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec made this lithograph poster in 1893.
items.tags: art nouveau, toulouse-lautrec, poster, lithograph, cabaret, belle epoque
items.credit_line: BnF Gallica, HTL 93 monogram, Chaix printer, second state "Jardin de Paris"

items.title: Reine de Joie
items.description_narrative: A woman in a red dress leans in to kiss a balding, heavyset man seated at a table, her arm wrapped around his shoulders. A mustached man in evening dress sits just behind them. Loose, sketchy lettering below advertises the novel the scene illustrates.
items.tags: cabaret scene, embrace, evening dress, novel advertisement, bold color, figures

items.title: La Revue Blanche
items.description_narrative: A woman in a fur-trimmed jacket and wide-brimmed feathered hat stands with one hand tucked at her hip, her polka-dot skirt swaying. A fur muff dangles from her other arm. Large curling script spells out the publication's name beside her.
items.tags: fashion, feathered hat, fur trim, polka dot, editorial poster, portrait
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the Metropolitan Museum of Art. See the Image and Data Resources Open Access Policy

items.title: May Belfort
items.cultural_context: Belle Époque, Post-Impressionism, French, Art Nouveau
items.description_narrative: A woman in a bright red gown and ruffled white bonnet cradles a black cat against her chest. Loosely sketched green lines suggest a wall behind her, leaving much of the paper bare. Her name is lettered simply beneath her feet.
items.tags: performer, red dress, black cat, minimal background, portrait, cabaret

items.title: Job
items.description_narrative: A reclining woman holds a lit cigarette between two fingers, her wavy dark hair spiraling into decorative curls that frame the whole composition. Her rust-orange wrap falls loosely from bare shoulders. The brand's name is worked directly into the swirling border pattern.
items.tags: art nouveau, cigarette, flowing hair, ornamental border, advertising, portrait

items.title: Bières de la Meuse
items.description_narrative: A woman crowned with wheat sheaves and red poppies lifts a foaming beer stein to her lips. Her auburn hair coils in loose curls against a leafy green backdrop. Small photographic views of brewery buildings appear in an oval beneath her.
items.tags: art nouveau, beer advertisement, poppies, wheat, brewery, decorative

items.title: Rêverie (Daydream) — F. Champenois Imprimeur-Éditeur
items.description_narrative: A woman with flowers woven through her hair looks out from within a swirling floral roundel, holding a blank tablet against her lap. This lithograph, printed for F. Champenois Imprimeur-Éditeur and dated 1898, is designed by Alphonse Mucha in his Art Nouveau style.
items.tags: art nouveau, poster, mucha, lithograph, advertising, fin de siècle

items.title: Zodiac
items.cultural_context: Art Nouveau, Fin de siècle, European
items.description_narrative: A woman in profile wears an elaborate jeweled headdress hung with chains and a crescent ornament, her long hair coiling into flowing loops below. Star-studded fabric drapes her shoulder, and a ring of zodiac symbols glows in a halo behind her head.
items.tags: art nouveau, zodiac symbols, jeweled headdress, profile portrait, decorative border, astrology

items.title: Rêverie
items.description_narrative: A young woman with flowers woven through her hair rests one arm on an open book, framed by swirling stylized vines and a floral halo rendered in flat, decorative color. Printed lettering runs across the top of the design, advertising a printing house. Alphonse Mucha created this design.
items.tags: art nouveau, mucha, poster, lithograph, floral, female figure, decorative, lettering
items.credit_line: BnF Gallica btv1b90051807, period impression lettered "F. Champenois Imprimeur-Éditeur ... 1898"

items.title: The Seasons: Spring
items.description_narrative: A woman plays a harp strung between blossoming branches, her long hair catching on twigs heavy with pale pink flowers. A small bird perches nearby among the blooms. Soft greens and whites fill the background behind her flowing white gown.
items.tags: art nouveau, spring, harp, blossoms, flowing hair, allegory

items.title: The Seasons: Autumn
items.description_narrative: A woman with flowing red hair and a crown of silvery chrysanthemums plucks grapes from a laden vine. She holds a shallow white bowl against her chest, her sheer gown catching the warm orange light. Trailing ivy and pink-tinged foliage fill the background.
items.tags: art nouveau, autumn, grape harvest, flowing hair, allegory, seasons

items.title: La Dame aux Camélias
items.description_narrative: A woman in a flowing cream gown gazes over her shoulder, a white flower tucked into her upswept hair. Small stars scatter across the deep pink background behind her. Below, a spray of white camellias grows from an ornate decorative border.
items.tags: theater poster, camellias, starry background, flowing gown, portrait, art nouveau
items.credit_line: Original file from Library of Congress

items.title: Monaco Monte-Carlo
items.description_narrative: A woman clasps her hands beneath her chin, gazing upward within a halo of birds and trailing blossoms. Delicate floral garlands curve outward on either side, framing a distant coastal landscape. The destination's name arcs in bold lettering across the top.
items.tags: travel poster, floral halo, coastal view, birds, art nouveau, monaco

items.title: Le Chat Noir
items.cultural_context: Art Nouveau, Fin de siècle Paris
items.description_narrative: A black cat sits alert with arched back and bristling whiskers, a glowing red halo radiating behind its head. Bold lettering announces a touring show beneath its perch. The simple, flat silhouette gives the animal a commanding presence.
items.tags: black cat, silhouette, cabaret, bold lettering, iconic poster, halo motif

items.title: Folies Bergère
items.description_narrative: A dancer twists mid-motion, her sweeping fabric shifting from rose to green against a plain black backdrop. Her bare arms and legs cut sharp silhouettes through the swirling drapery. Large lettering names the performer beneath her feet.
items.tags: dancer, swirling fabric, stage performance, bold silhouette, nightlife, motion

items.title: Folies-Bergère, La Loïe Fuller
items.description_narrative: In this variant of the same dance pose, the fabric glows orange and gold instead of rose, curling around the dancer like flame. Her red hair and pale limbs stand out sharply against the dark ground. The venue's name is lettered boldly above and below.
items.tags: dancer, flame colors, stage performance, silhouette, nightlife, motion

items.title: Bal du Moulin Rouge
items.description_narrative: A woman in a ruffled yellow dress rides astride a dark animal in a pointed cap, kicking up her heels amid a whirl of dancing figures. A red windmill looms in the background beside swirling crowd silhouettes. Large curved lettering announces the nightly ball.
items.tags: dance hall, windmill, festive crowd, yellow dress, lettering, nightlife

items.title: Salon des Cent
items.cultural_context: Art Nouveau, Fin de siècle, French
items.description_narrative: A woman with long, wavy auburn hair holds a pencil and portfolio in one hand while reaching toward a cluster of large white blossoms with the other. Her patterned dress falls in loose folds against a deep blue background. Bold lettering announces an exhibition above and below her.
items.tags: art nouveau, exhibition poster, portfolio, white blossoms, auburn hair, portrait

items.title: Absinthe Robette
items.description_narrative: A woman with wind-swept auburn hair raises a glass of pale green liquid above her head, her sheer white and yellow gown falling in soft folds. Trailing tendrils of smoke or vapor curl through the background like decorative vines. Large lettering spells out the advertised drink above her.
items.tags: art nouveau, advertising, absinthe, decorative lettering, ornament, belle epoque

items.title: Bitter Campari
items.description_narrative: A grinning red-haired clown in a black suit leaps and swings around a glowing yellow lamppost, one hand flung wide overhead. His pose radiates giddy motion against a plain warm-toned background. Bold lettering fills the top and bottom of the sheet.
items.tags: clown, lamppost, advertising, bold typography, italian, comic figure

items.title: Maurin Quina
items.description_narrative: A grinning green devil with curled horns and a pointed tail dangles a labeled bottle by its neck, one leg kicked up mid-stride. Sharp claws and a wicked expression give the figure a mischievous menace. The dark background makes the creature's green skin glow.
items.tags: devil, advertising, dark background, mischievous, aperitif, cappiello style

items.title: See America Welcome to Montana
items.description_narrative: A snow-streaked mountain rises above a dark band of pine forest, its slopes rendered in flat, angular shapes of white, tan, and rose. Below, a cluster of painted tipis sits on open grassland as a lone rider on horseback carries a flag past them.
items.tags: wpa poster, mountain landscape, tipis, mounted rider, screenprint, travel
items.credit_line: This image is available from the United States Library of Congress's Prints and Photographs division under the digital ID cph.3g04240.This tag does not indicate the copyright status of the attached work. A normal copyright tag is still required. See Commons:Licensing.

items.title: I Want You for U.S. Army
items.description_narrative: An older man in a star-spangled top hat and blue coat points straight at the viewer, his expression stern beneath bushy white brows. A red bow tie stands out against his white shirt. Bold red and black lettering below drives home the recruitment appeal.
items.tags: recruitment poster, uncle sam, pointing gesture, patriotic, world war i, propaganda
items.credit_line: This image is available from the United States Library of Congress's Prints and Photographs division under the digital ID ppmsc.03521.This tag does not indicate the copyright status of the attached work. A normal copyright tag is still required. See Commons:Licensing.

items.title: Destroy This Mad Brute
items.description_narrative: A snarling gorilla in a spiked helmet labeled 'militarism' strides ashore gripping a blood-stained club and a limp, half-dressed woman. Ruined buildings and a distant skyline glow behind him under a greenish sky. Bold lettering above and below drives home the recruitment message.
items.tags: propaganda, world war i, gorilla, recruitment, allegory, wartime poster
items.credit_line: This image is available from the United States Library of Congress's Prints and Photographs division under the digital ID ds.03216.This tag does not indicate the copyright status of the attached work. A normal copyright tag is still required. See Commons:Licensing.

items.title: When Hearts are Trumps
items.description_narrative: Two figures in profile lean close together, one offering a bowl of grapes cradled in her palm. Stylized grapevine leaves and clusters curl across the flat orange background in teal outline. Bold lettering beneath names the poem the image illustrates.
items.tags: art nouveau, grapevine motif, profile figures, flat color, illustration, decorative

items.title: Harper's March
items.cultural_context: Late 19th-century American graphic design, Art Nouveau influences
items.description_narrative: A woman in an off-the-shoulder black gown glances sideways, a small book held loosely in one hand. Above her float three decorative masks - a bearded face, a painted mask, and a grimacing one - against a plain tan ground. A bold red panel spells out the magazine's name beside her.
items.tags: magazine poster, masks, black gown, decorative panel, illustration, american
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the Metropolitan Museum of Art. See the Image and Data Resources Open Access Policy

items.title: The Boston Sunday Herald
items.description_narrative: A woman with closed eyes and softly waved hair rests within an arch framed by tall wheat-like stalks. Below her, an empty cream-colored panel would once have carried a printed date. Bold red lettering frames the whole design top and bottom.
items.tags: newspaper poster, decorative lettering, closed eyes, red and cream, easter, art nouveau
